quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: A broken yellow line between two lanes of traffic means:

options.text: Both lanes of traffic are going in the same direction.
You can pass when it is safe to do so.
Passing is not allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line separates traffic moving in opposite directions. You can pass when there is no oncoming traffic in the passing lane.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Disappear into blind spots or are too close for the truck driver to stop or turn safely.
Have plenty of space to travel behind the truck.
Have several car lengths between them and the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Disappear into blind spots or are too close for the truck driver to stop or turn safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spot areas around trucks where cars cannot be seen. A car in a "no zone" is also too close for the truck driver to stop or turn safely. This greatly increases the risk of a crash.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light warns that the light is about to turn red. If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you should:

options.text: Stop.
Continue through and clear the intersection safely.
Speed up to avoid causing an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue through and clear the intersection safely.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, continue through as quickly as possible to clear the intersection.

questions.question: After passing a vehicle, it is safe to move back into the right lane:

options.text: After about three seconds.
When you can no longer see the passed vehicle over your right shoulder.
When you can see the entire front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the entire front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: When passing, wait until you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror before returning to your lane. Always check your blind spots before moving back.

questions.question: As you approach an intersection with a flashing yellow light:

options.text: Stop before crossing the intersection.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Wait for a green light before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and check for cross traffic. Then proceed carefully.

questions.question: A blood alcohol concentration of 0.02 percent:

options.text: Will not affect your driving.
Will not put other drivers at risk.
Will double your chances of having an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Will double your chances of having an accident.
questions.explanation: Each 0.02 percent increase in blood alcohol concentration nearly doubles your risk of a fatal crash.

questions.question: This sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing without a signal. You should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop.
Keep a steady speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if you see or hear one.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if you see or hear one.
questions.explanation: At this railroad crossing, slow down, look both ways, and listen for trains. Be ready to stop. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: If you see orange construction signs and cones on a freeway, you must:

options.text: Slow down because the lane ends ahead.
Be ready for workers and equipment ahead.
Change lanes and keep your current speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for workers and equipment ahead.
questions.explanation: Construction signs warn of workers, slow equipment, and closed lanes ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should:

options.text: Turn on your high beam headlights.
Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
Speed up so you do not cause an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down and use low beam lights. If fog is too dense to see, pull over and wait for it to clear.

questions.question: If the road ahead is flooded, you should:

options.text: Slam on the brakes.
Do not drive through. Turn around and find another route.
Drive only in the center of the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive through. Turn around and find another route.
questions.explanation: Never drive through flooded water. It may hide hazards. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.
Change lanes suddenly or without warning.
Check for other vehicles moving into the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes suddenly or without warning.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors and blind spots before changing lanes. Always use your turn signal to warn other drivers. Make sure no vehicles are in your path.

questions.question: Which statement about driving speed is true?

options.text: As speed increases, so does the chance of a fatal crash.
As speed increases, you should increase your following distance.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: Higher speeds increase the risk of death in a crash. Faster speeds require longer stopping distances, so increase your following distance as you speed up.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, you should drive:

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
At the legal speed limit.
Slower than freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Merge at or near the speed of freeway traffic, unless traffic is moving faster than the legal speed limit.

questions.question: If you see a pedestrian with a guide dog or carrying a white cane:

options.text: The pedestrian must yield the right-of-way.
You must yield the right-of-way.
Honk your horn to alert them.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog indicates a blind or partially blind pedestrian. You must yield the right-of-way to them.

questions.question: When changing lanes:

options.text: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to be sure the lane is clear.
Check the inside rearview mirror.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to be sure the lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your side mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure it is safe.

questions.question: You want to park downhill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Straight ahead
Right, toward the side of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the side of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill on a road without a curb, turn your wheels toward the edge. This makes your car roll away from traffic if the brakes fail. When parking uphill on a road with a curb, turn your wheels toward the center instead.

questions.question: Which lane should you be in before turning left from a one-way street?

options.text: The lane nearest the left curb.
The lane nearest the center of the street.
The lane nearest the right curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane nearest the left curb.
questions.explanation: For any turn, use the lane closest to your direction of travel. For a left turn from a one-way street, use the lane nearest the left curb.

questions.question: When you drive through a construction zone, you should:

options.text: Stop to watch the workers.
Decrease your following distance.
Pass through carefully and do not slow down to look at things.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pass through carefully and do not slow down to look at things.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down to look at unusual things. This causes traffic congestion.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, or in rain or snow, it is hard to see. A good way to let other drivers know you are there is to turn on:

options.text: Your dashboard lights.
Your parking lights.
Your headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your headlights when you cannot see other vehicles clearly or when other drivers cannot see you. Always use low beam headlights if you need your windshield wipers.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving:

options.text: Use the brakes lightly.
Pump the brakes.
Apply the brakes hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the brakes lightly.
questions.explanation: Hold the steering wheel firmly and keep the car straight. Slow down gradually by releasing the gas pedal and using light braking.

questions.question: You exit the freeway on a downhill curve. You should:

options.text: Slow to a safe speed before the curve.
Slow to the posted freeway speed limit.
Begin braking after you enter the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to a safe speed before the curve.
questions.explanation: Always slow down before entering a curve. You may not see hazards ahead, and braking in a curve can cause your car to skid.

questions.question: You may legally block an intersection:

options.text: If you entered on a green light.
During rush hour traffic.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: Even if the light is green, do not enter an intersection unless you can cross completely before the light turns red. Blocking an intersection is illegal.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
A left turn is allowed only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: At a "Yield" sign, you must:

options.text: Give the right-of-way to traffic that is close enough to cause conflict.
Give the right-of-way only to vehicles on your right.
Always slow down and go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic that is close enough to cause conflict.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down or stop if needed. Give the right-of-way to any traffic that is close enough to cause a conflict.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see clearly, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Stay farther behind other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther behind other vehicles.
questions.explanation: In darkness or poor weather, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead. This gives you more time to react to hazards you may not see.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means passing is:

options.text: Allowed from the side with the solid yellow line.
Not allowed from either direction.
Allowed from the side with the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allowed from the side with the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to a solid yellow line, passing is allowed from the broken line side only.

questions.question: Which statement about changing lanes is true?

options.text: Look over your right shoulder for any lane change.
Look over your right shoulder for a right lane change and your left shoulder for a left lane change.
Two outside mirrors mean you have no blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your right shoulder for a right lane change and your left shoulder for a left lane change.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, signal and check all mirrors. Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot and make sure the next lane is clear.

questions.question: The speed limit near a school crossing is:

options.text: 10 mph.
15 mph.
25 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: 15 mph.
questions.explanation: When no other speed limit is posted near a school crosswalk, the speed limit is 15 mph.

questions.question: A broken yellow line down the center of a road means:

options.text: A construction zone is ahead.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means any driver may pass when it is safe and there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaching, you must:

options.text: Keep your speed and lane until it passes.
Move to the right lane and drive slowly until it passes.
Pull over to the edge of the road and stop until it passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the edge of the road and stop until it passes.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches, pull to the right edge of the road and stop. On one-way streets, move to whichever edge is closest.
